title: Surreal Melting Portrait
description: A close-up of a woman's face with golden eyes and blue and orange paint melting down her skin. She stands in a surreal desert landscape with cracked orange walls, a glowing purple portal containing a silhouetted figure, a full moon in a purple sky, and a black devil-like figure with glowing pink eyes holding a red rat on its hand.
prompt: Surreal scene featuring a large central portrait of a woman with golden glowing eyes as blue and orange liquid paint drips down her face. She is positioned in an impossible desert room with cracked orange walls and a reflective pink floor. A glowing purple circular portal shows a lone silhouetted figure. In the purple night sky floats a bright full moon. To the right, a black devil with glowing pink eyes holds a red rat on its outstretched hand. Symbolic eye on the wall, dramatic cinematic lighting.
